figs.name: lm35-temperature-sensor-pinout-arduino-wiring-diagram
figs.alt: LM35 temperature sensor pinout and wiring diagram to Arduino 5V, A0 and GND
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the LM35 TO 92 pinout with the flat face forward and its three wires to the Arduino Uno 5V, A0 and GND pins.
figs.after_h2: LM35 Temperature Sensor Pinout and Connection
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>LM35 temperature sensor pinout and wiring to Arduino Uno</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">LM35 Pinout and Arduino Wiring</text>
<path d="M110 230 L110 140 Q110 90 170 90 Q230 90 230 140 L230 230 Z" fill="#374151" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="170" y="170" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">LM35</text>
<text x="170" y="196" font-size="17" fill="#e5e7eb" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">flat face</text>
<line x1="140" y1="230" x2="140" y2="300" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="5"/>
<line x1="170" y1="230" x2="170" y2="300" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="5"/>
<line x1="200" y1="230" x2="200" y2="300" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="5"/>
<text x="225" y="280" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Flat face forward: 1 +Vs, 2 Vout, 3 GND</text>
<text x="140" y="224" font-size="17" fill="#fde68a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="170" y="224" font-size="17" fill="#fde68a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="200" y="224" font-size="17" fill="#fde68a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<polyline points="140,300 140,450 560,450" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3.5"/>
<polyline points="170,300 170,400 560,400" fill="none" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="3.5"/>
<polyline points="200,300 200,360 560,360" fill="none" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="3.5"/>
<rect x="560" y="300" width="200" height="190" rx="12" fill="#0f766e" stroke="#134e4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="660" y="330" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Arduino Uno</text>
<rect x="560" y="350" width="24" height="20" fill="#f3f4f6" stroke="#111827"/>
<text x="600" y="366" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">GND</text>
<rect x="560" y="390" width="24" height="20" fill="#f3f4f6" stroke="#111827"/>
<text x="600" y="406" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">A0</text>
<rect x="560" y="440" width="24" height="20" fill="#f3f4f6" stroke="#111827"/>
<text x="600" y="456" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">5V</text>
<text x="400" y="392" font-size="17" fill="#16a34a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Vout: 10 mV per °C</text>
<text x="400" y="442" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">+Vs: 4 V to 30 V</text>
<rect x="300" y="80" width="460" height="150" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="530.0" y="126.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Wiring notes</text>
<text x="530.0" y="149.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Fit 0.1 µF from +Vs to GND at the sensor</text>
<text x="530.0" y="172.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Keep one common ground with the ADC</text>
<text x="530.0" y="195.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Reversed supply makes it hot in seconds</text>
</svg>

figs.name: lm35-temperature-sensor-troubleshooting-flowchart
figs.alt: LM35 troubleshooting flowchart for 500 degree, zero, jumping or high readings
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a step by step check of LM35 faults, from a shorted output reading 500 degrees to a reversed supply making the sensor hot.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 580" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>LM35 troubleshooting flowchart for wrong temperature readings</title>
<rect width="800" height="580" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">LM35 Wrong Reading? Troubleshooting Flow</text>
<rect x="260" y="50" width="280" height="42" rx="10" fill="#dc2626" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="77.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reading looks wrong</text>
<line x1="400" y1="92" x2="400" y2="104" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="110" width="290" height="52" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="185.0" y="142.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reads about 500 °C?</text>
<line x1="332" y1="136" x2="396" y2="136" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="364" y="128" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="398" y="104" width="370" height="64" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="583.0" y="130.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Vout shorted to 5 V or open</text>
<text x="583.0" y="153.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">ground: check pin order, GND</text>
<line x1="185" y1="162" x2="185" y2="200" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="195" y="188" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="40" y="202" width="290" height="52" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="185.0" y="234.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reads 0 °C always?</text>
<line x1="332" y1="228" x2="396" y2="228" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="364" y="220" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="398" y="196" width="370" height="64" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="583.0" y="222.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Output open or wrong pin:</text>
<text x="583.0" y="245.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">confirm A0 in code and wiring</text>
<line x1="185" y1="254" x2="185" y2="292" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="195" y="280" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="40" y="294" width="290" height="52" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="185.0" y="326.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Jumps several degrees?</text>
<line x1="332" y1="320" x2="396" y2="320" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="364" y="312" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="398" y="288" width="370" height="64" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="583.0" y="314.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Noise or cable oscillation: add</text>
<text x="583.0" y="337.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0.1 µF bypass and RC damper</text>
<line x1="185" y1="346" x2="185" y2="384" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="195" y="372" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="40" y="386" width="290" height="52" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="185.0" y="418.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reads 2 to 5 °C high?</text>
<line x1="332" y1="412" x2="396" y2="412" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="364" y="404" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="398" y="380" width="370" height="64" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="583.0" y="406.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Self heating: move away from</text>
<text x="583.0" y="429.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">the regulator, reduce load</text>
<line x1="185" y1="438" x2="185" y2="476" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="195" y="464" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="40" y="478" width="290" height="52" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="185.0" y="510.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Body very hot?</text>
<line x1="332" y1="504" x2="396" y2="504" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="364" y="496" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="398" y="472" width="370" height="64" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="583.0" y="498.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Supply reversed:</text>
<text x="583.0" y="521.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">power off and rewire</text>
<text x="400" y="562" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Still wrong: compare with a reference thermometer at two points</text>
</svg>

figs.name: lm35-temperature-sensor-arduino-formula-infographic
figs.alt: LM35 Arduino ADC formula solved examples with 5 V and 1.1 V reference
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the LM35 ADC formula with two solved examples: reading 62 gives 30.27 degrees C at 5 V, and 233 gives 25.03 degrees C at 1.1 V.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>LM35 Arduino ADC formula with two solved examples</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">LM35 Arduino Formula: Two Solved Examples</text>
<rect x="40" y="60" width="720" height="96" rx="12" fill="#7f1d1d"/>
<text x="400" y="98" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Vout (mV) = reading × Vref × 1000 ÷ 1024</text>
<text x="400" y="134" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">T (°C) = Vout (mV) ÷ 10</text>
<rect x="40" y="176" width="350" height="290" rx="14" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="215" y="212" font-size="20" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Default 5 V reference</text>
<text x="64" y="254" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Reading</text>
<text x="366" y="254" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">62</text>
<line x1="60" y1="270" x2="370" y2="270" stroke="#fecaca" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="64" y="298" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Vout</text>
<text x="366" y="298" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">302.7 mV</text>
<line x1="60" y1="314" x2="370" y2="314" stroke="#fecaca" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="64" y="342" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Temperature</text>
<text x="366" y="342" font-size="19" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">30.27 °C</text>
<line x1="60" y1="358" x2="370" y2="358" stroke="#fecaca" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="64" y="386" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Fahrenheit</text>
<text x="366" y="386" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">86.49 °F</text>
<line x1="60" y1="402" x2="370" y2="402" stroke="#fecaca" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="64" y="430" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Step</text>
<text x="366" y="430" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">4.88 mV, 0.49 °C</text>
<rect x="410" y="176" width="350" height="290" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="585" y="212" font-size="20" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Internal 1.1 V reference</text>
<text x="434" y="254" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Reading</text>
<text x="736" y="254" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">233</text>
<line x1="430" y1="270" x2="740" y2="270" stroke="#fecaca" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="434" y="298" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Vout</text>
<text x="736" y="298" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">250.3 mV</text>
<line x1="430" y1="314" x2="740" y2="314" stroke="#fecaca" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="434" y="342" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Temperature</text>
<text x="736" y="342" font-size="19" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">25.03 °C</text>
<line x1="430" y1="358" x2="740" y2="358" stroke="#fecaca" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="434" y="386" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Range ends</text>
<text x="736" y="386" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">near 110 °C</text>
<line x1="430" y1="402" x2="740" y2="402" stroke="#fecaca" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="434" y="430" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Step</text>
<text x="736" y="430" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">1.07 mV, 0.11 °C</text>
<text x="400" y="500" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Short form for 5 V: T = reading × 500 ÷ 1024</text>
</svg>
